group.label: General Settings
group.comment: Address autocomplete for storefront address forms, powered by Google Places API (New). V2 runs independently of the legacy Customers > Google Address Search (V1) module: while V1 is enabled for a store view, V2 stays inactive there so the two never attach to the same field or double-bill. Disable V1 for a store view to switch it to V2.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Set per website or store view to limit address search to specific storefronts.

field.label: Enabled On Forms
field.comment: Address search attaches to the first street line of each selected form.

field.label: Debug Logging (Browser Console)
field.comment: Logs request, cache and session events to the browser console. Never logs typed input, addresses or API keys. Keep disabled in production.

group.label: Google API Configuration
group.comment:
Required APIs in the Google Cloud project: Maps JavaScript API and Places API (New). The legacy "Places API" is not used.
Recommended key restrictions: Application restriction = Websites (HTTP referrers) listing only your storefront domains; API restriction = Maps JavaScript API + Places API (New). Set a daily quota cap and a billing alert in Google Cloud.

field.label: Browser API Key
field.comment: Used by the Maps JavaScript API in the shopper's browser, so it is visible in page source by design. Protect it with HTTP referrer and API restrictions. Use a separate key per environment (production, staging, local) so each can be restricted to its own domains. No server-side key is needed: V2 makes no server-to-Google calls.

field.label: Maps JavaScript API Version
field.comment: "Quarterly" is the stable channel Google recommends for production. "Weekly" gets fixes sooner.

group.label: Search Behavior and Performance
group.comment: Every autocomplete request in a session that does not end with a selection is billed individually, so these settings directly control cost.

field.label: Minimum Characters
field.comment: No request is sent until the trimmed input reaches this length (1-20). Recommended: 3-4.

field.label: Debounce Delay (ms)
field.comment: Waits for a pause in typing before searching (0-2000). Recommended: 250-400.

field.label: Minimum Interval Between Requests (ms)
field.comment: Hard rate limit per field on top of the debounce (0-5000). 0 disables it.

field.label: Maximum Suggestions
field.comment: Suggestions shown per search (1-5). Google returns at most 5; showing fewer does not reduce cost.

field.label: Suggestion Place Types
field.comment: Comma-separated place types, at most 5. Default limits suggestions to deliverable addresses. Leave empty to allow all types (businesses, landmarks).

field.label: Country Restriction
field.comment: "Country selected in the form" gives the most relevant results and resets the search when the shopper changes country. Google accepts at most 15 countries per request.

field.label: Restrict to Countries
field.comment: Used by "Fixed list", and as the fallback for "Country selected in the form" while no country is selected. Maximum 15.

field.label: Language
field.comment: Language of suggestions and address components, e.g. "en", "af" or "zu". Empty uses the store view locale.

field.label: Region Bias
field.comment: Two-letter ISO code used to format and rank results. Default: ZA (South Africa). Note: SA is Saudi Arabia, not South Africa.

field.label: Session Idle Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: A session token groups the keystrokes of one search with the final selection, making the autocomplete requests free when it ends in a selection. A new token is started after this much inactivity (30-600). Recommended: 180.

field.label: Skip Searches After No Results
field.comment: When a search returns nothing, longer inputs starting with the same text are not sent to Google again in that session.

field.label: Disable Browser Autofill on Search Field
field.comment: Prevents the browser's own address dropdown from covering the suggestions. Other address fields keep browser autofill.

group.label: Field Population and Mapping
group.comment: Selecting a suggestion makes one Place Details (New) request for addressComponents only (Essentials tier) and ends the session.

field.label: Populate Address Fields
field.comment: If disabled, a selection only copies the suggestion text into the street field and no Place Details request is made. Abandoned sessions are billed per request, so this rarely saves money.

field.label: When a Component Is Missing
field.comment: E.g. the selected place has no postcode. Clearing avoids keeping a postcode from a previously entered address.

field.label: When the Search Field Is Cleared
field.comment: Fields the shopper edited after selection are never cleared.

field.label: Field Mapping
field.comment:
Target: a Magento field code (street.0, street.1, city, postcode, country_id, region, company...) or a CSS selector scoped to the form (starting with #, . or [). region selects the State/Province option, or fills the text field for countries without a region list.
Template: Google component types in braces, e.g. {route} {street_number}. Add :short for the short form ({country:short}) and use | for fallbacks ({locality|postal_town}). Missing parts and leftover separators are removed.
Form / Countries narrow a row (comma-separated ISO codes; South Africa is ZA, SA is Saudi Arabia). For each target the most specific matching row wins: form + country, then form, then country, then rows for all forms.
